basis: CWL provider-neutral external metadata observation admission semantics
normative_requirement: A consumer MUST accept every valid_vectors value with its expected_reason_code, MUST return a rejected receipt with the expected_reason_code for every rejected_vectors value, MUST reject every invalid_vectors value and invalid_json_texts text before minting any receipt, and MUST derive every replay_vectors expected_replay_id. Foreign sources MUST NOT be promoted to authoritative, superseded, or rejected; JSON Schema validation alone is insufficient for authority, tenant, replay, and supersession invariants.
replay_derivation: SHA-256 over UTF-8 JSON array ["cwl-external-metadata-replay/v1", source_authority, tenant_id, external_entity_type, external_id, source_release, payload_sha256] with separators "," and ":" and no other whitespace
